description: This Java class implements the <field-to-result> element for the MiniLang language in the OFBiz framework, handling mapping of fields to results within method operations.

classes.name: FieldToResult
classes.description: Implements the <field-to-result> element, mapping a field value to a result map, with support for nested expressions.

classes.name: FieldToResult.FieldToResultFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToResult.

methods.name: FieldToResult
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on XML element attributes, validating attributes and setting up map accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves a field value from the environment map and stores it into the results map, handling nested expressions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including field and result-name attributes.
